questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET MAY 2023
questions.stem: A female was brought for autopsy with an alleged history of being found at a lake in the village. All of the following are suggestive of antemortem drowning except:

options.label: B
options.text: Excessive salivation & froth from nose and mouth

questions.solutionHtml:
Washerwoman's hands
  • Washerwoman's hands and feet are a non- specific sign of submersion. They occur due to the imbibition of water into the outer skin layers. They can be seen in antemortem as well as postmortem drowning victims.


KNIGHT’S FORENSIC PATHOLOGY 4TH EDITION PAGE NO 399

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET MAY 2023
questions.stem: A person had an alcohol smell along with conjunctival redness. He was able to walk stably and had all motor functions normal:

options.label: B
options.text: He took alcohol and not under its influence

options.label: C
options.text: He took alcohol and is under its influence

questions.answerText: He took alcohol and not under its influence
questions.solutionHtml:
He took alcohol and not under its influence
  • The given situation of a person who smells of alcohol but whose motor coordination is normal with no slurring of speech is suggestive that he has consumed alcohol but is not under its influence
  • The presentation of an alcoholic smell and congested conjunctiva suggests the influence of the alcohol on the individual. These are common signs associated with alcohol consumption.


The essentials of forensic medicine and toxicology ,33rd edition page no 579,580

Blister due to antemortem burns

questions.stem: The Tactile hallucinations seen in cases of chronic cocaine intoxication is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Formication
  • Formication is the feeling of insects crawling across or underneath your skin.
  • This is a complication of chronic cocaine use.
